## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 08.04.2026 - 30.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _FM_, 30.08.2026, 1/5: "buggy after saving run causes white screen freeze pleas fix it asap"
            2. _Bluesdude55_, 20.08.2026, 1/5: "Poor and getting worse on Android...Sign in / Login issues everytime. Wasting too much time before being able to open app & start activity. No default setting retention. Auto Pause & type of activity setting should be set/forget similar to the Audio stat choice that remain checked or enabled. Actively looking for new app that works on the first launch. Purchase Information incorrect shows that I have over 400 days left on my subscription but using Free App Go version. don't recommend."
            3. _Mikołaj Ściobłowski_, 08.04.2026, 1/5: "Laughably bad programming. The voiceover will spam you with useless info instead of playing interval audio cues, a bug that was present FIVE YEARS ago. [08/04/26] The most poorly coded running app managed to get even worse, it doesn't even launch now, congrats asics."
<!--/ir-theme-->
